lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A semi-regular grid of high-luminance circular spots is visible posterior to the gill slits, transitioning from dense, smaller clusters near the head to larger, more isolated centroids spaced roughly 2-3 diameters apart in the mid-flank region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Distinct vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect horizontal rows of blobs to form a grid-like matrix; the intersections function as primary anchor nodes for the pattern topography.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A visible horizontal ridge extends across the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp luminance transition from a high-intensity upper edge to a low-intensity shadow region immediately below.

other_distinctive_markers: The right pectoral fin exhibits a unique density of small, high-contrast spots on its dorsal surface; two remoras (Echeneidae) are visible: one attached ventrally near the pectoral fin base and another swimming adjacent to the lower flank.
